# Sai Samarth Tours – Tour Packages & Pilgrimages from Bangalore

> Sai Samarth Tours is a premier travel agency and pilgrimage tour operator based in Yelahanka New Town, Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. Established in 2013 and having served over 20,000+ devotees and travelers, the agency specializes in direct flight pilgrimages, deluxe AC pushback bus yatras, senior-citizen-friendly spiritual tours, domestic holiday vacations, and international packages departing from Bangalore Kempegowda International Airport (BLR). All packages include confirmed VIP darshan, verified 3-star AC accommodations, pure vegetarian meals (South & North Indian), and dedicated on-ground tour managers.

## Key Agency Facts & Trust Signals

- **Head Office:** No. 2238, 2nd Floor, 16th 'B' Cross, Yelahanka New Town, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560064, India
- **Branch/Counter:** Shop No. 04, Ground Floor, 1st Main Rd, Opposite to Railway Wheel Factory, Attur Layout, Yelahanka New Town, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560064
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +91 91877 11649 / +91 98444 87649
- **Email:** info@saisamarthtours.com / info.saisamarthtours@gmail.com
- **Official Website:** https://saisamarthtours.com
- **Core Specialties:** Direct flight Shirdi yatras, 12 Jyotirlinga circuits, Char Dham, Kashi-Ayodhya, Puri Jagannath, Kamakhya Shaktipeeth, senior citizen assisted tours with wheelchair coordination, and pure vegetarian dining.

## Important Booking & Cancellation Policies

- **Meals:** All tour meals provided by Sai Samarth Tours are 100% pure vegetarian (Jain food options available on prior request).
- **Accommodation:** Guaranteed verified 3-star and 4-star AC hotels with clean private bathrooms and lift access.
- **Flight Policy:** Flight tickets booked under group/promotional fares are non-refundable and subject to airline scheduling terms.
- **Cancellation Policy:**
  - 15 days or more prior to departure: 50% tour cancellation fee applies.
  - Less than 15 days prior to departure: 100% cancellation fee applies.
  - View full policy: [Cancellation & Refund Policy](https://saisamarthtours.com/cancellation-policy)
- **Legal Terms:** [Terms of Use](https://saisamarthtours.com/terms-of-use) | [Privacy Policy](https://saisamarthtours.com/privacy-policy)
- **Technical Sitemap:** [XML Sitemap](https://saisamarthtours.com/sitemap.xml)
- **Comprehensive LLM Context:** [llms-full.txt](https://saisamarthtours.com/llms-full.txt)
